**Read this first.** Two small pieces from the maps around Barcelona, both built and unplayed.
Neither touches anything an earlier release built. If you would rather wait for a build
somebody has walked, wait.

## The gate remembers you

Walk into the Mongol Camp and the guard challenges you -- *"Stand fast and be recognized,
knave!"* -- once. After that the gate is silent for the rest of the game, whatever you did.
The greeting written for a player the camp had let through -- *"Greetings goblin friend. What
do you want?"* -- was in the file and nothing opened it. It plays now on every return through
the gate, with the audience ask and the Darsh ask behind it, and a way to say nothing and walk
on. Pick a fight from it and the camp turns, the same as it always did from the first meeting.

## Brendan's clover

The Irish sailor at the Port District tavern bar has a line about noticing you're down on your
luck and pressing a clover into your hand -- *"plucked from the last patch of dry ground 'afore
me island sank. Legend says it be magic, so keep it safe..."* It was never reachable, the clover
existed only as an unused icon in the game's cache, and the "Luck three or less" test it needs
was a requirement the game shipped and never asked anywhere. Take his drink with Luck 3 or
lower and he hands it over. **Sullivan's Clover** is a charm worn at the neck for +1 Luck --
that part is ours; the line, the icon and the test are the game's.

## Read and left alone

Seven other leads around Barcelona were run down and turned out to be earlier drafts of things
the game does another way: the undead that were once going to guard Cortes's treasure, a
Bishop-Diego flag nothing reads, the goblin shaman's ransom that was once the river dryad's
head before it became the devil fish, an older copy of Raylark's whole conversation, four
Cortes tavern nodes pointing at replies that live in Shylocke's tree, and two copies of scenes
that are live under another name. The full account is in `docs/releases.md`.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over 0.9.0 as normal.

**The gate needs a character who has not yet entered the Mongol Camp**; a level's contents are
captured into your save the first time you walk in. The clover is dialogue and a new item, and
works on any save whose character hasn't already taken Brendan's drink.
